🛰️ **Multi-Modal Optical + SAR Joint Extraction Assessment**

By combining multispectral optical reflectance with C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) microwave backscatter through Intensity-Hue-Saturation (IHS) fusion, we cleanly separated built-up and water-covered regions:

### 1. 🏘️ Identified Built-Up & Infrastructure Regions
• **Surface Coverage:** Built-up structures cover **~100.0%** (104.82 km² / 10,482 hectares).
• **SAR Identification Mechanism:** Vertical walls, concrete structures, and metallic port/industrial assets produce strong **double-bounce radar backscatter**, clearly illuminating urban footprints through optical clouds and atmospheric haze.
• **Delineation:** Marked with **amber-orange boundary vectors** on the fused evidence canvas.

---

### 2. 💧 Identified Water-Covered Regions
• **Surface Coverage:** Water bodies cover **~0.9%** (0.96 km² / 96 hectares).
• **SAR Identification Mechanism:** Smooth water surfaces act as specular reflectors that bounce radar pulses away from the sensor, creating unambiguous **low-backscatter dark regions** that accurately trace coastlines, channels, and drainage basins.
• **Delineation:** Marked with **cyan boundary vectors** on the fused evidence canvas.

---

### 📊 Quantitative Multi-Modal Cross-Fused Surface Matrix

| Surface Feature / Land Class | Surface Coverage | Estimated Area (km²) | Area (Hectares) | Sensor Exploitation Mechanism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 🏘️ **Built-Up & Urban Infrastructure** | **100.0%** | **104.82 km²** | **10,482 ha** | High SAR double-bounce dihedral backscatter + optical edge contrast |
| 💧 **Hydrological Water Bodies** | **0.9%** | **0.96 km²** | **96 ha** | Specular microwave reflection (dark SAR return) + optical blue-green absorption |
| 🌳 **Vegetation & Forest Canopy** | **0.1%** | **0.13 km²** | **13 ha** | Volume scattering in microwave + high optical NDVI green reflectance |
| 🪨 **Open Ground / Bare Terrain** | **0.0%** | **0.00 km²** | **0 ha** | Surface roughness microwave scatter + exposed ground reflectance |
| 🌐 **TOTAL DELINEATED SCENE** | **100.0%** | **104.86 km²** | **10,486 ha** | **Full Optical + Microwave SAR Multi-Modal Fusion** |

---

### 3. Tactical Visual Evidence & Co-Registration Verification
• The visual evidence canvas displays the **IHS-fused composite** integrating SAR roughness textures into optical true-color channels.
• Use the **interactive swipe comparison slider** in the Trace panel to seamlessly transition between the Optical and SAR layers.
